dish.title: Mushroom Walnut Bolognese
dish.name: Mushroom Walnut Bolognese
dish.description: Mushroom and walnut sauce over spaghetti, salted as the mushrooms brown and in the pasta water.

recipe_version.title: Mushroom Walnut Bolognese
recipe_version.description: Mushroom and walnut sauce over spaghetti, salted as the mushrooms brown and in the pasta water.
recipe_version.doneness: Mushrooms deeply browned. Sauce thick. Pasta al dente.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Divided: 28 g in 3 qt pasta water (about 1%), 4 g on the mushrooms as they brown. 32 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (11.5 tsp). The same weight is 6.75 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 5.25 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Brown
steps.body: Cook the cremini mushrooms and the walnuts in the olive oil with 4 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt until the mushrooms are deeply browned. Work in batches if the pan is crowded.

steps.title: Simmer and boil
steps.body: Add the garlic, crushed tomatoes, and black pepper. Simmer 20 minutes. Meanwhile bring the water to a boil with the remaining 28 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (about 1% by weight, 28 g per 3 qt) and boil the spaghetti until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.body: Taste the sauce and add salt only if it still tastes flat. Toss the spaghetti with the sauce, loosening it with pasta water if it looks thick.
